maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The uppermost keypoints are positioned approximately 1.5 to 2 spot-widths vertically above the primary dense row, following a trajectory roughly parallel to the upper margin of the rhinarium.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 98% melanin saturation; pixels are consistently dark across the apex and wings with only minute traces of lighter pigmentation at the extreme ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a vertical green blade of grass occluding the lower right portion of the vibrissae field and chin.
